name: Campeche

queries.query: Campeche Mexico official cadastral parcel map cadastral viewer INFOCAM municipality
queries.result: First-party discovery identified INFOCAM, the Instituto de Información Estadística, Geográfica y Catastral del Estado de Campeche, with its official IDE and cadastral-information pages; the official H. Ayuntamiento de Campeche services page identifies a predial consultation route and local cadastral service context. INFOCAM's current public IDE route was reachable, but the parcel viewer and cadastral management route require login; no anonymous parcel feature response was obtained.

queries.query: Campeche México visor catastral parcelas catastro oficial INFOCAM Ayuntamiento Campeche
queries.result: La búsqueda en fuentes de primera parte identificó al INFOCAM como instituto estatal de información estadística, geográfica y catastral, su IDE oficial y la página oficial de servicios del H. Ayuntamiento de Campeche con consulta de predial. La IDE actual fue accesible, pero el visor catastral y el Sistema de Gestión Catastral muestran acceso con usuario; no se obtuvo una respuesta anónima de parcela con identificador y geometría.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: H. Ayuntamiento de Campeche, whose official services page identifies the local predial consultation and links to the Campeche predial service; the municipal cadastral function is also evidenced by the official Dirección de Catastro form and municipal planning material.
officialSourceAssessment.stateCadastralCustodian: Instituto de Información Estadística, Geográfica y Catastral del Estado de Campeche (INFOCAM).
officialSourceAssessment.stateParcelService: INFOCAM IDE at https://ide.infocam.gob.mx/ and its linked IDE visor route; the current public viewer source shows a login gate before opening visor/.
officialSourceAssessment.cadastralManagementService: INFOCAM Sistema de Gestión Catastral at https://sgc.infocam.gob.mx/sgc/, reachable anonymously only to its login page.
officialSourceAssessment.registryBasis: Official state and municipal sources identify real cadastral custodians and services. This supports registryFound=true for source discovery only, not geometry coverage or adapter qualification.
officialSourceAssessment.registryFoundReason: INFOCAM's official IDE describes state cadastral/geospatial responsibilities and exposes cadastral-information links; the official municipality service page exposes a Campeche predial route and local government contact context.

schemaAndCrs.inspectionNote: The official IDE landing page was retrieved and its JavaScript/configuration inspected. The current visor route is opened only after the page's login flow; the SGC route likewise returned a login page. No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response, schema, CRS, or public feature endpoint was obtained. The municipal predial link is a payment/consultation route, not a qualified parcel-geometry service.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not executed against a qualified anonymous parcel endpoint; the exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official INFOCAM state cadastral/IDE services and H. Ayuntamiento de Campeche local predial/cadastral service evidence.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official service identity and local/state custodian evidence only; no parcel geometry, map extent, or citywide coverage.
